objective: Test whether the B0xy versus middle magnetic response association repeats within +X and +Y directions.
baseline: Actual applied directional baseline 1, B0xy=hypot(mean Bx,mean By).
response: Per-trial mean a_control_uT during straight_hold projected path distance 10–40 mm. Use distance along the direction, including X; do not filter X records using y displacement.
preparation: Each stroke on unused paper; same paper/support/brush and the same water preparation per stroke; no hand adjustment of magnetic bristles.
analysis: Analyze X and Y separately; each trial is one observation. Report Pearson r, Spearman rho, 95% confidence intervals with assumptions, response/time and baseline/time plots, influence and temporal trend sensitivity. Inspect loaded raw XY field and signed delta components to assess subtraction coupling. Include every completed planned trial regardless of its B0xy/response.
exclusions: Exclude only documented aborted/incomplete trials, invalid acquisition/baseline, confirmed incorrect Z/speed, or accidental preparation changes. Retain excluded source runs and reason. Record any replacement attempt separately; never repeat because a response looks unwanted.
range_limit: If baseline magnitudes barely vary compared with baseline measurement noise, the data characterize repeatability but cannot establish the response dependence over a wide B0xy range.
